title: rosa viscaria var. lemanii
intro: Rosa viscaria var. lemanii, commonly known as the alpine rose, is a flowering plant species within the genus Rosa. It is a type of rose that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia, and is valued for its medicinal properties. The alpine rose is rich in antioxidants and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, wounds, and digestive problems, due to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Rosa viscaria var. lemanii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its health benefits and medicinal uses.
